Defaulted false; flagged uncertain because a gate could exist deeper on the unmapped internal road.

fieldNotes.dockDoors: Distillery loading is modest: a covered loading area on the distillery building's west side with a few loading positions for grain receiving and product/DDGS shipping. Band 0-10. Distilleries are low-dock-count operations.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Small SW laydown/equipment yard with a few trailers; not a true trailer drop lot. Band 0-10.
fieldNotes.scale: A truck scale is plausible for grain receiving at a distillery but not clearly identified in imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural Marion County KY location; the site sits in a small industrial cluster off KY-208, not deeply isolated, so cellular coverage is likely adequate - set false but flagged medium-confidence.

fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - Lebanon KY, rolling farmland in Marion County.
